items.source: Strategy interface to compute column projection to be selected for a query based on a given EntityProjection. A projection function can be composed into a higher-order function using otherwise(ProjectionFunction) to form a chain of functions that are tried in sequence until one produces a non-empty Columns object.
items.translation: 用于根据给定的EntityProjection计算要选择的查询列投影的策略接口。投影函数可以通过使用otherwise(ProjectionFunction)组合成高阶函数，形成一系列按顺序尝试的函数链，直到其中一个生成非空的Columns对象。

items.source: Compute Columns to be selected for a given EntityProjection. If the function cannot compute columns it should return an empty Columns object.
items.translation: 计算给定Columns以选择用于特定EntityProjection的列。如果函数无法计算列，则应返回一个空的Columns对象。
